name: Feeds Paragraphs

suggests.drupal/feeds_tamper: For splitting a single source column into multiple paragraph values (https://www.drupal.org/node/2287473).

consumes_plugin_types: feeds_target (Drupal\feeds\Plugin\Type\Target — provides the wrapper_target FeedsTarget plugin)
implements_hooks: hook_feeds_targets_alter (removes the raw Paragraphs entity_reference_revisions target so sub-fields are mapped instead)
hook_entity_update (runs RevisionHandler when the host entity carries fpm_targets)
provides_services: feeds_para_mapper.revision_handler (Drupal\feeds_para_mapper\RevisionHandler) — creates paragraph revisions and prunes unused paragraphs on update
ecosystem_note: A Feeds add-on with NO config page, permissions, Drush, or config of its own (enabling it exposes no UI). It plugs into the Feeds mapping UI: when a Feed Type's processor targets an entity that has a Paragraphs field (entity_reference_revisions), FeedsTarget::targets() walks the referenced paragraph bundles and surfaces each supported LEAF field (nested and multi-valued included) as its own mapping target, labelled `Field (host_field:nested_host_field)`. The raw `paragraphs` target that core Feeds would otherwise offer is stripped by hook_feeds_targets_alter (with a 'please refresh the page' warning). At import time the wrapper_target plugin delegates to the real field's own target plugin but redirects the write into Paragraphs entities that Importer creates, duplicates, updates, or slices (by the per-mapping 'Maximum Values' cardinality). On entity update, hook_entity_update hands off to RevisionHandler which creates new paragraph revisions and removes now-unused paragraphs. Field discovery/import state is carried on cloned FieldConfig objects via a non-persisted `target_info` property (Utility\TargetInfo: type/plugin/path/in_common/has_settings/max_values/properties/paragraphs). Requires feeds ^3.0 + paragraphs (+ entity_reference_revisions, shipped with paragraphs). For splitting one source column into several paragraph values, pair with Feeds Tamper.
